meta_title: LP Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Southampton
meta_description: LP Heating and Plumbing offer expert gas engineering, boiler installs, and plumbing across Southampton. Gas Safe registered, fast response. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Southampton's Trusted Heating Experts
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, gas safety checks, and heating problems sorted quickly — by a local engineer you can trust.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, LP Heating and Plumbing covers every aspect of gas and plumbing work in Southampton and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Supply and installation of energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers. We'll advise on the right model for your home and complete the install to the highest standard, leaving you with a full manufacturer warranty.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of boiler faults, keeping your home warm and your family safe. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running efficiently and helps avoid costly breakdowns.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full central heating system design and installation for new builds and older properties. We ensure even heat distribution throughout your home and a system built to last.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord gas safety inspections and CP12 certificates issued by our Gas Safe registered engineer. Essential for rental properties and recommended for all homeowners annually.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework
services.desc: New radiator installations, replacements, and power flushing to restore full heat output. We also carry out all copper and plastic pipework alterations and installations.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and urgent plumbing faults attended to as a priority across Southampton. Call us and we'll aim to get an engineer to you the same day.

about_pullquote: Every job is done right — whether it's a small repair or a full installation.
about_para_1: LP Heating and Plumbing is a Southampton-based gas and plumbing business serving homeowners and landlords across the city and surrounding areas. Founded with a commitment to honest, high-quality work, we are fully Gas Safe registered and carry out all work in compliance with current UK gas and building regulations.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we give straightforward advice, transparent pricing, and a job completed to the standard we'd expect in our own homes. Based in Bitterne, Southampton, we understand the local area and take pride in being a trusted name that neighbours recommend to neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About LP Heating & Plumbing

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Our boiler packed in overnight and LP Heating had an engineer with us by late morning. Fixed quickly, no fuss, and the price was very fair. Will definitely use again and have already recommended to a friend.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had a new combi boiler fitted last month. Really impressed with how tidy and professional the whole job was. Everything was explained clearly and the engineer took time to show me how to use the new controls. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Called for a landlord gas safety certificate on short notice and they were able to come out within two days. Certificate issued on the day, great communication throughout. Exactly what you want from a local tradesman.
reviews.author: Priya S.
